description: Priority opaque, seamless ground/terrain tiles for the base TileCode set. Each is a full-fill terrain tile (not a transparent cut-out) so the world renders solid instead of dark. Display-only TileCode intent (never authority): grass->GRASS(0), stone_ground->STONE(1), water->WATER(3); dirt_path/cobblestone are town ground variants. Production backlog only — all prompt_written; NOT generated/cleaned/normalized/reviewed/promoted. Generation needs OPENAI_API_KEY (tools/asset-gen/.env, --background opaque) plus the human style-board + review gate per FACTORY.md.
